items.text: LA Rams (final report): OUT - LG Steve Avila (hamstring), TE Terrance Ferguson (ankle/hamstring). QUESTIONABLE - CB Trent McDuffie (back), S Kam Curl (toe), OLB Myles Garrett (knee/rest), TE Davis Allen (oblique), LS Joe Cardona (ankle). IR - WR Puka Nacua (knee/toe), WR Davante Adams (hamstring), CB Jaylen Watson, DE Kobie Turner, DT Poona Ford, K Blake Grupe. Matthew Stafford starts.
items.source: TheRams.com (Rams Injury Report, Week 10 at Cardinals)

items.text: Arizona (final report): OUT - QB Gardner Minshew (elbow), C Hjalte Froholdt (concussion), RG Jon Gaines II (ankle), DT Zach Carter (knee). QUESTIONABLE - LT Jayden Williams (knee), DT Roy Lopez (toe/ankle), CB Max Melton (knee/hand), TE Hunter Long (knee), S Andrew Wingard (groin), DL Darius Robinson (wrist). Season-ending - WR Michael Wilson, WR Kendrick Bourne, LT Paris Johnson Jr. IR - RB Jeremiyah Love. Rookie Carson Beck makes his first NFL start (no prior start, so no qb_start override; the model still prices Minshew); Josh Johnson signed as backup.
items.source: CBS Sports (NFL Week 10 injury report: final game statuses, Nov 13)
